verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a hosted SaaS that processes user data, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack has no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or a zero-data-retention mode. Self-hosting the AGPL version and the API-key and IP-allowlist controls are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
